name: Machine Learning Specialization
summary: The canonical entry point to machine learning, rebuilt in Python with hands-on labs in every module.

name: Deep Learning Specialization
summary: Five courses covering neural network fundamentals through convolutional and sequence models.

name: Practical Deep Learning for Coders
summary: Top-down teaching: you train a working state-of-the-art model in lesson one, theory arrives later.

name: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science
summary: A famously demanding but well-taught foundation in how computers and programs actually work.

name: Natural Language Processing Specialization
summary: From bag-of-words classifiers to attention models, with each technique implemented from scratch.

name: Hugging Face NLP Course
summary: Free, current, and entirely practical: fine-tune and ship transformer models using the modern stack.

name: Data Science Professional Certificate
summary: A long, gentle on-ramp to data science aimed squarely at career changers with no coding background.

name: Google Data Analytics Certificate
summary: Job-focused analytics training with an employer consortium attached; light on programming depth.

name: The Complete Web Developer Bootcamp
summary: A very long full-stack video course that takes an absolute beginner to deployed CRUD applications.

name: Full Stack Open
summary: Free university-grade modern JavaScript curriculum with genuinely difficult exercise sets.

name: AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate
summary: Exam-oriented cloud training with hands-on labs; the certification itself costs extra.

name: Docker and Kubernetes: The Complete Guide
summary: Builds a multi-container application and deploys it, rather than lecturing about container theory.

name: Mathematics for Machine Learning Specialization
summary: Rebuilds the specific maths that ML actually uses, with visual intuition ahead of proofs.

name: SQL for Data Science
summary: A short, focused SQL course that gets a non-programmer querying real tables in about a month.

name: Andrej Karpathy: Neural Networks Zero to Hero
summary: Builds an autograd engine and then a GPT from scratch, line by line, with nothing hidden.

name: Google UX Design Certificate
summary: Produces three portfolio pieces; long duration is the main cost for a career switcher.

name: Financial Markets
summary: A Nobel laureate's overview of how markets, risk and financial institutions actually behave.

name: CS50's Introduction to Artificial Intelligence with Python
summary: Classical AI plus modern ML, taught through demanding weekly projects rather than quizzes.

name: Algorithms Specialization
summary: Rigorous algorithm analysis; heavy on proofs, and the usual choice for interview preparation depth.

name: Python for Everybody Specialization
summary: The gentlest credible introduction to programming; pace is slow if you already code.

name: Generative AI with Large Language Models
summary: A short, current course on the LLM lifecycle from pre-training economics through RLHF.

name: Introduction to Statistics
summary: Covers exactly the inferential statistics an evaluation section of a research project needs.

name: The Complete Financial Analyst Course
summary: Spreadsheet-first finance training; strong on mechanics, light on theory.

name: Machine Learning Engineering for Production (MLOps)
summary: The operational half of ML: drift, pipelines, versioning and serving under real constraints.

name: Learn Prompting
summary: A short free reference on prompting techniques with citations back to the source papers.

name: Introduction to Cyber Security
summary: Conceptual security grounding without lab access; good for orientation, not for hands-on skills.

name: Blender Complete 3D Course
summary: Makes a portfolio of finished 3D renders; needs a reasonably capable GPU to follow comfortably.

name: Recommender Systems Specialization
summary: The only mainstream course dedicated entirely to recommender theory, evaluation and metrics.

name: Design of Experiments
summary: How to design an ablation or A/B study that will survive a reviewer's statistical objections.

name: Vector Databases and Embeddings
summary: A one-week primer on embedding retrieval — exactly the stage-one machinery of a hybrid recommender.
